result.summary: Refactors transaction construction in blockpolicyestimator_tests and mempool_fee_estimator_tests to initialize inputs and outputs directly using constructors and initializer lists instead of mutating templates and resizing vectors. In blockpolicyestimator_tests, it also deduplicates repetitive logic for constructing and submitting mempool entries to the fee estimator into an add_tx helper.
result.problem: Fee estimator unit tests construct test transactions imperatively through vector resizes and repeated field assignments, and blockpolicyestimator_tests duplicates identical transaction-submission boilerplate across three separate test loops.
evidence: Part of tracking issue #36692 (Declarative construction of test data)
result.changed_since_previous: No functional or structural changes; diff provided for the first time.
result.card: This PR refactors unit test transaction setup in blockpolicyestimator_tests and mempool_fee_estimator_tests to use direct constructor calls and initializer lists rather than mutating templates and resizing vectors. It also extracts repeated fee estimator submission boilerplate into an add_tx helper function. The change is part of tracking issue #36692, with no intended behavior change.

risk.why: Only touches unit test transaction generation helpers; an error could cause test failures but cannot affect production nodes.
